contexts.text: Lest any goods with them should seduce the upright.
As those in natural good are easily seduced, Moab is called... AC 8315.
Those in the natural good of evil love... sutler themselves to be easily seduced...
And shall seduce many () = that there will be derivations from (false doctrine). AE 734:24.
He that persevereth unto the end = him who does not suffer himself to be seduced.
I shall be in his eyes as one who seduces () = rejection because apparently contrary to order.
One who seduces, or a seducer = contrary to order: all seduction is nothing else.
Truths which they pervert in order to seduce. Signified.
Such, when they lived here, suffered themselves to be much seduced by the deceitful...
Lest they should seduce simple upright Spirits.
The delight of their life will be to ratiocinate... and thus... seduce others.
When any want to seduce (the Spirits of Saturn)... they say they would rather die.
Falsities from the fallacies of the senses do not seduce them...
Seduction thence in the Word itself. Signified, Explained.
Poverty equally seduces...
By appearances of good... they would seduce the simple...
Dignities and wealth seduce some, and some they do not seduce. Explained.
For in all evil there is the lust of seducing.
Lest (the souls under the altar) should be seduced. Signified.
That seduces the whole world () = that they pervert all things of the Church. AE 741.
On account of the cunning of those who seduce (the New Church grows cautiously). Signified, Explained.
Accosting novitiates with the design of seducing them. Signified.
To seduce () = to lead into errors. ( = to persuade of falsities. AE 826.)
By thy sorcery were all the nations seduced () = their wicked arts... by which they have led away the minds of all... AE 1191.
With which he seduced them that received the mark of the beast... () = ... by faith alone have induced others to receive that faith...
Have seduced the laity and the common people.
To seduce () to draw to their party.
The devil that seduced them () means the dragon (that is) those who are in evils as to life and in falsities as to doctrine.
On the lust of seducing innocences. General article.
Those who... seduce (by fallacies) may be compared to...
Such, who are seducers, are let out to men in the world...
Spirits can be greatly misled in their judgments concerning Souls. Explained.
Thus the human race is especially seduced by these...
Sirens who... delude and seduce...
Spirits complained that (thus) they have nothing by which to seduce; for by such (objections) they very greatly seduce men.
Such (Sirens) can seduce also the upright.
These are interior seducers.
Thus they can seduce even the intelligent.
To seduce () is predicated of goods or evils.
The spiritual sense of these words (is) for men in the world who are in good, when the evil try to seduce them.
Their seduction by the serpent, means their seduction by the Sensuous...
Man is led to such things as do not seduce.
